qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the idler lever to alternator bracket screw?
What is the torque specification for the screw plug for bearing pin?
What size is the screw plug for bearing pin?
Which component requires the higher torque specification - the idler lever screw or the bearing pin screw plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The idler lever to alternator bracket screw requires higher torque at 90 Nm compared to the bearing pin screw plug at 20 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the specification for the screw that needs to be replaced according to item 1AZ?
What section of the manual is this torque specification table from?
What component system does item 11 28 relate to?
qa_pairs.answer: V-ribbed belt with tension and deflection element

qa_pairs.question: What instruction is given for the idler lever to alternator bracket screw?
How many different torque specifications are listed for the V-ribbed belt system?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque specifications are listed: 90 Nm and 20 Nm
